basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Lead AI Native Engineer | Agentic Coding & Software Factories | Client-Facing Technical Lead | MBA
basics.summary: Engineer, product owner, and tech lead in one. 13+ years shipping AI-native systems to production and handing the keys back: AI agents that 2x outbound conversions at LumApps, LLM pipelines that eliminated $337K in vendor cost at Beekeeper in 6 weeks, autonomous drone deliveries at Dronistics. Daily driver of agentic coding workflows (Claude Code, MCP, spec-driven, multi-agent orchestration). Founded three AI-native companies on the side to stay at the frontier. I set the engineering bar (tests, CI/CD, observability, eval harnesses) because AI amplifies the system it lands in.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Owns AI transformation end-to-end, from production agent architecture to company-wide governance, sales enablement, and change management. Reports directly to C-level on outcomes.
highlights: Owned an AI outbound sales agent from fuzzy business problem to production: wrote the backlog, built the system with agentic workflows (LangChain, FastAPI, GCP), rolled it out to SDR and AE teams. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day. Forecast $4M approved opportunities per quarter.
Expanded scope to lead company-wide AI transformation strategy and governance. Teaching engineers, product, and sales how to work AI-native and making the new way of working stick.
Built AI Brain, an intelligent context layer over conversations, usage, and notes. Chose what to ship and what to cut based on business signal, not demo appeal.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Technical lead who operates like a founding engineer. Owns the problem, writes the backlog, ships to prod, sets the engineering bar, and grows the team around it.
highlights: Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation cost with an in-house LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks (GitHub Actions plus OpenAI, with an eval harness gating quality). 12K+ assets translated, product team iterates without external gatekeepers. Handed the keys back to product.

Architected the Employee Referral System end-to-end as Tech Lead reporting to the CIO. Became the platform's top revenue channel ($1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR). Owned scope, backlog, GTM, and 99.99% SLA.

Built the AI engineering cohort at Beekeeper. Hired for craft, mentored engineers to lead features independently, and set the bar for tests, CI/CD, observability, and LLM eval harnesses (Langfuse, CrewAI, Strands Agents).

Co-owned GTM launches with Product and Sales (Seasonal Templates, Re-ignite Revenue, Sentiment Analysis). Each shipped with instrumentation so we knew within a week if it moved the metric. Killed the ones that did not.

work.name: Tenity
work.summary: Technology panelist and mentor for seed-to-VC startups. Evaluates architecture, AI adoption, and engineering culture; advises founders in front of investors.
highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups on technical architecture, scalability, and AI readiness. Pushed back on hype in front of investors and founders; recommended what would survive production and what would not.
Mentored portfolio companies on technical hiring, AI strategy, agentic tooling adoption, and building engineering cultures that ship.

work.name: Dronistics
work.summary: Founding engineer for an autonomous drone delivery system. Built the whole stack from scratch and stayed accountable to the metric: safety and delivery speed.
highlights: Shipped the end-to-end delivery platform (Vue, Java, PostgreSQL, AWS). 500+ real-world deliveries, 99.5% safety record, zero incidents. Built CI/CD and cloud infra from scratch so the bar held even as we scaled partnerships with Unilever and a CES showcase.
Engineered real-time flight control APIs and logistics optimization. 40% faster deliveries, enterprise-grade reliability that customers could trust their brand to.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
work.summary: AI research at the frontier of robotics. Built and scaled Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot morphologies and control systems via genetic algorithms.
highlights: Engineered Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot bodies and brains via genetic algorithms. Migrated the simulation pipeline to AWS for large-scale parallel runs; work featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.
Teaching Assistant for Evolutionary Robotics at EPFL. Supervised 20+ master's students hands-on: change management practice for engineers picking up unfamiliar tooling.
Foundational AI experience (optimization, search, fitness landscapes, learning from environment) that shapes how I approach LLM and agentic systems today.

projects.name: PulseView - AI Market Intelligence
projects.description: Real-time market analysis platform where AI agents both generate and justify trading signals. Built for my own portfolio first; opened to retail traders after self-validation. Core principle: if the model cannot explain the signal, it does not ship.
highlights: Multi-agent workflow that fuses technical and news-based inputs, produces a signal, and generates the rationale. Explainability gates every ship. Live product with real users.

projects.name: Proplab - AI for Real Estate
projects.description: AI-native MVP for small real estate teams. Vision models turn inspection photos into structured records; LLM agents turn those records into multilingual, marketing-ready listings end-to-end.
highlights: Single agent workflow from photo capture to published listing, zero copy-paste. Built spec-driven with an eval harness so a bad extraction never becomes a bad listing.

projects.name: SwissNRI - AI Cross-border Fintech
projects.description: AI-native platform for Swiss-Indian families navigating FEMA, DTAA, and Swiss tax regulations. Zero-to-MVP in 3 months with a compliance-first agentic design.
highlights: RAG-grounded tax assistant that answers cross-border compliance questions in plain language with citations back to the regulation. Regulatory guardrails built before features; 40% uplift in user satisfaction from feedback-driven iteration.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: Lead AI Native Engineer. re:cinq is a hands-on engineering consultancy. Own delivery end to end (prototype to production, hand back the keys), run it like a product owner (fuzzy business problem to sequenced backlog), build at the top of the ladder (orchestrate multiple coding agents in parallel, spec-driven, MCP, software-factory patterns), set the engineering bar (tests, CI/CD, observability, validation harness), lead the behaviour change (teach client engineers to work AI-native, train the trainers), push back on hype. Bar: 7+ years shipping to prod, led teams, daily fluent agentic coding, product instinct, fluent across 2+ stacks, at ease with clients and execs. Bonus: consulting, MCP servers, change management, public work.
